request.spec:
On a client's page show me just their active projects by default. Give me a way to also see
the finished and hidden ones.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
On a client's page show me just their active projects by default. Give me a way to also see
the finished and hidden ones.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Here's a summary of the full-stack change I made.

## What changed

A client's page now shows **only their active projects** (ACTIVE status, not archived) by default, with a **"Show finished and hidden projects" toggle** that reveals the rest.

### Server
- **`ProjectRepository.findViewsByClientId`** — widened the client's project query to include archived rows (removed the `AND p.archived = FALSE` filter). It already carried each project's `status` and `archived` flag, so the front-end can now filter without a second request. Filtering moved from SQL to the UI, matching how the main projects list already works.
- **`TestSupportController` seed** — the projects seed now inserts the `archived` flag from the fixture (it previously only set `id, name, client_id, status`), so a seeded `archived: true` project is actually archived.

### Front-end (all additive, per the slot/URL-key conventions)
- **`features/clients/queries.ts`** — widened `ClientProject` to carry `status` and `archived`; added the shared `CLIENT_PROJECTS_SHOW_ALL_PARAM = 'clientProjectsAll'` URL key and an `isActiveProject` helper.
- **`features/clients/ClientProjectsTable.tsx`** — reads the `clientProjectsAll` URL key and filters to active projects unless the toggle is on. Reuses the existing `project-row-<id>` / `project-name` anchors.
- **`features/clients/show-all-projects.slot.tsx`** (new) — the toggle, a `ClientDetail` slot contribution owning the same URL key, with `data-testid="client-projects-show-all"`.

### No migration
The `status` (V17) and `archived` (V12) columns already existed, so no new Flyway migration was needed — the feature is served entirely by existing schema plus the query/seed/UI changes.

Test: `1 passed`.
